title: Far view test: sky, haze and a model of the whole island
question: Should this far view go to every outdoor place, or what should change first?

options.label: far-roll-out: roll it out to every outdoor place
options.note: Every outdoor place gets the sky, haze, island model and full-height buildings, and the ?far=1 flag goes away. The places themselves need no change; it is one list in game3d/js/look/far-flag.js.

options.label: far-change: change something first
options.note: Say what in the comment: the sky colours for a time of day, how thick or close the haze is, the trees or buildings in the distance, the mainland on the horizon, or anything else.

links.label: Old works with the far view (desktop, third-person camera)

decision: Roll out as a first step: "Works well as a first step. Still a lot of exterior areas that are just not built for this yet that seem super empty, but that is for pass 2". Pass 2 is #375.
